t: You're looking at a seated bronze statue of Sigmund Freud, on a limestone plinth in the grounds of the Tavistock Clinic, where Fitzjohns Avenue meets Belsize Lane in Hampstead. It is the work of the sculptor Oscar Nemon, who was born in Osijek in Croatia, settled in England, and is best known for his many statues of Winston Churchill. Freud, the founder of psychoanalysis, lived close by at 20 Maresfield Gardens for the last months of his life. That house is now the Freud Museum.
